retryProtocol.initialFailureRetention: An initial red remains a red receipt; an isolated retry may diagnose it but never replaces it.
retryProtocol.isolatedRetry: Re-run each failed file once in isolation, then record any later full-suite run as a separate numbered attempt.
retryProtocol.acceptance: Every numbered full-suite run (1) must exit zero and leave the proof worktree clean; isolated green is diagnostic only.
